operation: Extract seeded random sources, noise functions, texture recipes and geometry builders into a PCG dump.
required_evidence: seed or algorithm per random source
steps: Pin the demo id, commit and source hash, then search seed, random, noise, permutation and hash helpers.
Split noise functions from texture recipes and from geometry or placement builders.
Link random to noise to recipe to consumer with resolvable related entities.
Attach generated results only from a runtime record; otherwise leave them out and record the gap.
acceptance_checks: Every entity carries inputs, outputs, determinism and evidence.
Line ranges fall inside the pinned source file.
No PCG node graph is claimed when only explicit builders were observed.

on_failure.retry: Re-run only the failed step after fixing the referenced evidence.
on_failure.stop: Stop when the source hash is unknown or a generated result cannot be tied to an observation.
